description: Fastener presets shared by every project. Project configs reference these by id instead of restating clearance tables, so a corrected clearance applies everywhere at once.

provenance.source: vendored in each project's ref/ spec markdown; the three Strymon, Line 6 specs agree

notes: Counterbored holes are not modelled here; any pedal config that sets countersink=false takes the plain clearance diameter only.
The head_clearance_dia_mm range is a check on the countersink tool, not a tolerance on the screw.
